fl-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its county commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
fl-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Florida's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
fl-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

fl-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City, Town or Village card names the place you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
fl-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Florida's cities, towns and villages has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
fl-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's, town's and village's mayor and council members, or a place's own published list of them.

fl-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
fl-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Florida's 67 school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
fl-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

fl-tribal-government.area: The Miccosukee Tribe's land in Broward, Miami-Dade, Hendry and Highlands counties, and the Poarch Band of Creek Indians' sliver of trust land in Escambia County
fl-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the council of the Seminole Tribe of Florida, from the tribe's own page. It names nobody for the Miccosukee Tribe or the Poarch Band of Creek Indians.
fl-tribal-government.why: Both tribes' own sites answered this project with a check only a person in a browser can pass, which this project does not get around.
fl-tribal-government.wanted: A list of the Miccosukee Tribe's Business Council and of the Poarch Band's Tribal Council, from each tribe, that this project may read.
